release_notes: Interactive onboarding walkthrough — learn every feature before your first dictation
Mic permission check at startup — no more silent failures if mic access is denied
RegisterHotKey replaces pynput — no longer flagged by antivirus as keylogger
Paste retry with error flash — no more silent data loss if paste fails
Cancel dictation mid-recording with the × button
Hotkey sound can now be toggled in Settings
Pill border color now reflects active mode (green / purple / blue)
